justification: Both surfaces carry low-relief profile quadrupeds occupying a horizontal field, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows a single, highly schematic, isolated creature with a raised curving tail and no human presence, while B shows a naturalistic bridled horse with harness details accompanied by a human figure in cap and garment, plus a second register of further figures below. The rendering conventions differ sharply — bare outline with minimal interior detail versus modelled musculature, incised manes, and patterned trappings — so nothing suggests a shared iconographic scheme.
